tweaks.name: Review startup apps (you pick what to disable)
tweaks.why: Every tray app (launchers, chat, updaters, RGB suites) costs CPU and RAM and can wake up mid-match. Same switch as Task Manager > Startup apps, so anything can be re-enabled there.
tweaks.breaks: Apps you disable no longer start at login (open them manually).

tweaks.name: Stop Store apps from running in the background
tweaks.why: Store apps (Weather, News, Mail, Phone Link...) keep background tasks alive even when closed.
tweaks.breaks: Store apps won't refresh or notify while closed.

tweaks.name: Stop uploading Windows updates to other PCs (Delivery Optimization P2P)
tweaks.why: By default Windows can seed update files to other PCs, using your upload bandwidth and raising ping. Downloads from Microsoft keep working.

tweaks.name: Disable telemetry services (DiagTrack, WAP push)
tweaks.why: Connected User Experiences and Telemetry collects and uploads usage data on a schedule. Safe to turn off; Windows Update and the Store keep working.

tweaks.name: Disable telemetry scheduled tasks (Compatibility Appraiser, CEIP)
tweaks.why: Compatibility Appraiser (CompatTelRunner.exe) is known for random CPU and disk spikes. These tasks only collect telemetry.

tweaks.name: Disable Print Spooler (no printer found)
tweaks.why: No physical printer was detected. The spooler is an always-on service and a well-known attack surface (PrintNightmare).
tweaks.breaks: Printing and 'Microsoft Print to PDF'. Revert this if you get a printer.

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Search indexing
tweaks.why: The indexer scans and re-scans files in the background, heavy on hard drives and weaker CPUs.
tweaks.breaks: Instant file search in Explorer/Start and Outlook search. Apps are still found from Start.

tweaks.name: Disable SysMain (Superfetch) on SSD-only PCs
tweaks.why: SysMain preloads apps into RAM. On SSD-only PCs the benefit is small and it can cause disk activity spikes. Keep it on PCs with a hard drive.
tweaks.breaks: Apps may open slightly slower the first time.
